title: One-Breakdown Limit on Out-of-Area Repair Reimbursements
content:
Under Road Hazard Protection, a tire repair that belongs to the same breakdown as a tow or a roadside dispatch is held, together with it, to a single breakdown limit on the repair part of the out-of-area repair reimbursement.

**Repair breakdown limit.** When the most recent out-of-area tow reimbursement on the certificate by service date is dated no more than 30 days (the plan's receipt window) before the reimbursement date — the tow of the same breakdown — the repair part is the lower of the plan's out-of-area repair cap and the plan's tow cap plus the out-of-area repair cap less the amounts of the out-of-area tow reimbursement entries on that tow's claim number (a Crestline dispatch paid on the same claim number is not counted here); when there is no such tow but the most recent Crestline roadside service entry on the certificate by service date is dated within that window, the repair part is the lower of the out-of-area repair cap and the plan's flat-change cap plus the out-of-area repair cap less the amounts of the Crestline roadside service entries on that dispatch's claim number; otherwise the repair part is the out-of-area repair cap.

| On the certificate | Repair part |
|---|---|
| most recent out-of-area tow reimbursement dated within 30 days before the reimbursement date | lower of: repair cap; tow cap plus repair cap less the tow reimbursement amounts on that tow's claim number |
| no such tow; most recent Crestline roadside service entry dated within 30 days | lower of: repair cap; flat-change cap plus repair cap less the roadside service amounts on that dispatch's claim number |
| neither | repair cap |

**Plan figures used (USD).**

| Plan | Repair cap | Tow cap | Flat-change cap |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12-Month | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| 24-Month | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| 36-Month | 30.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Plus 36 | 35.00 | 100.00 | 75.00 |
| Life-of-Tread | 40.00 | 125.00 | 85.00 |
| Commercial LT | 35.00 | 100.00 | 75.00 |

*Hypothetical cases (Life-of-Tread figures).* A tow reimbursed 125.00 ten days earlier: the lower of 40.00 and 125.00 plus 40.00 less 125.00, that is 40.00. A tow reimbursed 140.00 on that claim number: the lower of 40.00 and 25.00, that is 25.00. A Crestline flat-tire change paid 85.00 twelve days earlier and no tow: the lower of 40.00 and 40.00, that is 40.00. A most recent tow 31 days before the reimbursement date: the repair part is 40.00.
